# Active work — evidence-intake-project

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## Unparented

### Text-to-frame retrieval over scene keyframes as the visual finder, instead of more detector classes

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.video.keyframe-embedding-retrieval/1`

Embed each scene keyframe once with a CLIP/SigLIP-class image encoder behind the VisionBackend-style trait (JSON backend for tests, local CLI or ONNX for overnight runs) and store the vector against the derived still, so a lawyer can later ask for frames matching "person on the ground", "handcuffs", "firearm", "vehicle interior at night" without the adapter having predicted the class. A query returns SearchHit-style locators (original hash, time range, still) ordered by identifier within a similarity cut, never a similarity number, and every hit is a suggestion a person looks at; recall is preferred over precision because a false positive costs one look and a false negative hides evidence. Retrieval never writes an observation or an edge; only what a reviewer confirms is authored. Vectors are stored per case in SQLite (a blob column or the sqlite-vec extension), never shared across cases, and excluded from every export.
